jobs.description_text: About Fullscript We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care. That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment. We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better. This is your invitation. Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care.

jobs.description_text: Our Company Welcome to Energy Vault® (NYSE:NRGV), a global energy storage and power infrastructure company focused on owning, operating, and enabling resilient, dispatchable energy assets. Energy Vault’s focus is to deliver reliable, flexible power that supports the evolving needs of modern grids, communities, and large energy users. Since 2024, the Company has centered its strategy on an Independent Power Producer (IPP) model, developing, building, owning, and operating critical energy assets around the world. Energy Vault operates globally, with headquarters in Westlake Village, California and Lugano, Switzerland, and regional development across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The Company partners with utilities, grid operators, and large energy consumers to deliver infrastructure that strengthens grid reliability, enables renewable integration, and supports long-term energy security. jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description_text: FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise. Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments. As a Solutions Architect, you'll play a valuable role within the FireMon Customer Experience team, helping to assess business opportunities and support the development of strategies to address technical challenges. In this role, you'll work closely with security architects, infrastructure specialists, and engineering teams within customer organizations, gaining hands-on experience designing effective, results-driven solutions. You will support both Pre-Sale (Buyer's Journey) and Post-Sale (Customer Journey) phases, building your technical expertise and product knowledge along the way. With guidance from senior team members, you'll help empower customers to make informed decisions and achieve success in their projects.

jobs.title: Bid Coordinator
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Bid Coordinator is the organizational backbone of the bid team. Working alongside Bid Managers and Bid Specialists, this role makes sure every bid runs to a rigorous, well-managed process, so that deadlines are met, contributors know what is expected of them, and nothing falls through the cracks. This is a process and project coordination role rather than a content or strategy role. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive: someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, keeps many moving parts on track at once, and is comfortable following up with colleagues across the business to keep work moving. It is a strong entry point for someone looking to grow a career in bid management.

Responsibilities: 

  • Bid Planning and Scheduling Support
    • Support Bid Managers in building bid plans that work backward from the submission date, including milestones, review gates, internal deadlines, and buffer time. 
    • Set up and maintain bid trackers, schedules, and responsibility matrices (e.g., RACI) for each pursuit.
    • Keep plans up to date as timelines shift, and flag schedule risks to the Bid Manager early.
  • Tracking, Follow-Up, and Accountability

The Director, Bid Strategy & Pricing (“Bid Director”) leads how Lyft Urban Solutions identifies, shapes, and wins new business. jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. To do this, we start with our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization.

The Lifecycle Growth Marketing team engages with millions of Lyft riders and drivers to drive preference and usage of Lyft. The team runs hundreds of acquisition, engagement, retention and resurrection experiments every year across email, push notifications, SMS and in-app messaging surfaces. 

We are data-driven in everything we do. We test and measure all of our communications and tailor experiences to be personalized and contextual by audience segment. 

In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, and Marketing Operations to design, test and optimize incentive and non-incentive messages and experiences. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own the lifecycle marketing strategy for your audience — define the channel mix, set the prioritization framework, and ensure every communication delivers clear value to the target user
  • Build and manage an experimentation program that drives measurable impact — from ideation through results, with a clear point of view on what to test 
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science to unlock new platform capabilities, influence roadmaps, and push beyond out-of-the-box tooling

jobs.description_text: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead. At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role Veeva Link is transforming how the global life sciences industry connects with Key Opinion Leaders in Healthcare. Our applications span every stage of market maturity, from established industry standards to fast-growing emerging solutions, so there is always something new to learn and real room to grow. Our Strategy team owns the market success of our products, from shaping product direction to making sure customers realise lasting value. We are now expanding the Strategy team with a new client value function, and we are looking for a highly motivated Strategy Associate to join the team. Working side by side with our Strategy Directors, you will take direct ownership of client engagement across some of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Bewerbermanagement (mind. 15h/Woche)
jobs.description_text: Wir haben ambitionierte Ziele. Werde ein Teil davon. Von 0 auf 40 Teammitglieder in fünf Jahren. Wir gehören als Mix aus Strategieberatung und Kreativagentur zu den am schnellsten wachsenden inhabergeführten Beratungsunternehmen Süddeutschlands und möchten unseren Weg auch in Zukunft erfolgreich fortsetzen. Hinter unserem „wir“ steht dabei ein Kollektiv aus engagierten Persönlichkeiten, was vielseitiger nicht sein könnte. Von ehemaligen Unternehmensberatern renommierter internationaler Unternehmen wie Ernst & Young oder Porsche Consulting über kreative Designprofis und Content-Experten bis zur TikTok Influencerin oder dem studierten Videografen, wir sind in unseren Fähigkeiten unterschiedlich, haben aber doch eine große Gemeinsamkeit: den Anspruch, uns kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und herausragende Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen. About Pandektes Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland. About the role As our Head of DACH Sales, you’ll lead our sales team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland and take ownership of growing one of our key markets. You’ll manage and develop a team of Account Executives working across a wide range of customers and deal sizes. jobs.description_text: Stabiliteit is geen toeval. Maar wie is er verantwoordelijk voor? Achter elke applicatie die dag en nacht beschikbaar moet zijn, staat iemand die dat bewust heeft ingericht. Die de IT-keten kent, problemen ziet aankomen en weet hoe je een organisatie meeneemt in wat er speelt. Niet reactief, maar structureel. Ben jij die professional? De uitdaging Grote organisaties in luchtvaart, overheid en aanverwante sectoren werken met systemen die miljoenen gebruikers bedienen en verweven zijn in brede IT-ketens. Er is geen ruimte voor halve maatregelen, want een verstoring raakt niet één team, maar een hele organisatie of zelfs miljoenen gebruikers in heel Nederland! Je gaat in dienst bij LINKIT en werkt aan complexe projecten bij een van onze klanten. jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description_text: Techniek is nooit het eindpunt, het is het startpunt van elke transformatie Elke organisatie heeft een verhaal over waar ze naartoe wil. De vraag is of de technologie dat verhaal ondersteunt of tegenwerkt. Als Solution Architect bij LINKIT bepaal jij het antwoord: je vertaalt strategische ambities naar architectuur die houdt, schaalt en meebeweegt. De uitdaging Als Solution Architect beweeg je je tussen twee werelden: je haalt nieuwe opdrachten binnen én je maakt ze waar. Je komt in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in overheid, finance en logistiek. Aan de ene kant ben je een belangrijke schakel in ons presalesproces. Je schuift aan bij prospects, denkt mee over hun vraagstuk en vertaalt dat naar een overtuigende technische oplossing. Samen met de Account Executive en Business Consultants zorg je voor de technische onderbouwing die de doorslag geeft, van eerste gesprek tot gewonnen opdracht. Aan de andere kant ga je, eenmaal binnen, zelf aan de slag als architect. Je werkt aan kernapplicaties die het digitale fundament van onze opdrachtgevers versterken, evalueert technische keuzes en borgt integratie binnen complexe applicatielandschappen. Zo versnel je de digitale transformatie van organisaties die geen ruimte hebben voor half werk. Je verbindt strategie, technologie en uitvoering, en werkt daarbij nauw samen met onze technische squads en experts op het gebied van security, privacy en informatiehuishouding.
